scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,agents --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w agents"
scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['web','agents'].forEach(d=>{try{fs.symlinkSync('../.env.local',d+'/.env.local');}catch(e){if(e.code!=='EEXIST')throw e;}}); console.log('ok: .env.local symlinked into web/ and agents/');"
